name: Dropdown Dialog Node
description: Adds a workflow node that turns a configurable key/value list into a runtime dialog dropdown; the user's selection is written to runtime variables. Built purely on the public SDK — no host changes.

nodes.label: Dropdown Picker
nodes.description: Pauses the run with a dropdown built from the configured items and stores the selection in variables.

fields.label: Dropdown items
fields.description: Key = label shown in the dropdown, Value = what gets stored. {{variables}} in values are substituted at run time.

fields.label: List items
fields.description: Optional plain list shown as a second dropdown in the same dialog; the picked item is stored as-is. {{variables}} are substituted at run time.

fields.label: List item variable
fields.description: Runtime variable that receives the item picked from the list dropdown.

fields.label: Value variable
fields.description: Runtime variable that receives the selected item's value.

fields.label: Label variable
fields.description: Runtime variable that receives the selected item's key/label. Leave blank to skip.
